mechanics.title: Persistent grid
mechanics.description: Ingredients stay in the crafting table between uses instead of returning to your inventory, and are drawn on the block along with the craftable result. A tag (visualworkbench/tags) controls which crafting tables are supported.

editor_notes: Required on client and server; requires Puzzles Lib and Forge Config API Port.
name: Visual Workbench
summary: Crafting tables keep the items placed in the grid when you close them, and render the ingredients and result on top of the block. Breaking the table drops the contents.
